title: Native operation log
description: What cst op log --json prints in a native repository (CLI output; native/cli/src/native_operations.rs, ADR-0047 decisions 10 and 12): the operations the current one reaches through parents, newest first, each before every operation it follows (docs/native-history/operations.md §3), as many as -n allows. cst op show --json prints one with its view (causet.operation/v1).
